name: OBO Lab
description: API collection for OBO Lab: run the on-behalf-of exchange scenario end to end against in-process mock issuer, exchanger and downstream (inbound token, actor claims, delegated token, downstream call, delta and leak analysis), and decode the mock tokens. Everything is a labelled mock; the lab has no live mode.

folders.name: Sanity (mock, labelled)
folders.description: Health, mode info, and the scenario catalog (persona, agent, exchanger, downstream).

folders.name: Run the OBO exchange
folders.description: One run produces the whole story: inbound token, actor, delegated token, downstream call, the claim delta and the leak analysis. Decode inspects a pasted token; revoke clears state.
